# Badgepath

> Badgepath is a free, open-source web app that shows which GitHub achievements a public profile has earned and estimates how close the next tier is. It needs no sign-in, sets no cookies and uses only public GitHub data. It is an independent project and is not affiliated with GitHub.

## Use it

- [Home](https://badge-path.vercel.app/): enter a GitHub username or profile address
- Profile pages live at `https://badge-path.vercel.app/<github-username>`

## What it shows

- Achievements a profile has earned, with the tier (Default, Bronze, Silver, Gold) that GitHub displays
- Estimated progress toward the next tier where GitHub exposes a usable public count
- Public profile statistics: repositories, followers, contributions and streaks

## Limits

- Pair Extraordinaire, Quickdraw, Galaxy Brain, Public Sponsor and other achievements without a public count get no numeric estimate
- Private-repository activity is not visible
- Only the 100 most recently updated owned repositories are read
